note: The per-field provenance schema the desk grounds every answer in. Three properties this file enforces. (1) EVERY FIELD HAS A TTL - there is no 'static' escape hatch, because 'immutable by construction' is a claim about the contract and the read that established it can still be from a block that got reorged out. (2) `serveWhenStale` IS FALSE EVERYWHERE, and turning it true requires a written justification in the data itself plus an age disclosure in the answer; the default is no and it is a no someone has to argue past. (3) `class` IS RECOMPUTED FROM `source` at load, so a ledger figure cannot be filed as a chain read - and a derived field may declare itself weaker than its inputs but never stronger. `selfCheck` is emitted verbatim whenever a field is absent or aged out, so 'I do not have that' is still a usable answer. TTLs mirror FACT_TTL_SECONDS in packages/desk/src/factsheet/fields.ts.

fields.label: the contract address
fields.method: Consent.token, bound by trusted operator code at onboarding and never read from user text
fields.selfCheck: Compare the address pinned in the project's own channel against the one on the pool page in the block explorer. If they differ, trust neither and ask in the open channel.
fields.note: Operator-asserted rather than a chain read, and that is the honest label: we bound this at onboarding. It is also the field an impersonator most wants to change, which is why the desk refuses it rather than guessing.

fields.label: the chain id
fields.method: VENUE.chainId in config/protocol.ts
fields.selfCheck: Check the network your wallet is on against the chain id shown by the block explorer for this token.

fields.label: the Venue version
fields.method: TokenLaunched on the V2 factory 0x7eD598BcEf8bd9Edd8C97A195C6d13f40801EC7e
fields.selfCheck: Open the token's contract-creation transaction in the explorer and read which factory deployed it.
fields.note: V1 is unsupported. A token with no TokenLaunched log on the V2 factory has no answer here, and the absence is itself the answer.

fields.label: the token name
fields.method: name()
fields.selfCheck: Read name() on the token contract in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the token symbol
fields.method: symbol()
fields.selfCheck: Read symbol() on the token contract in the explorer's Read tab. A symbol is not unique; check the address too.

fields.label: the token decimals
fields.method: decimals()
fields.selfCheck: Read decimals() on the token contract in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the launch time
fields.method: block timestamp of the TokenLaunched log
fields.selfCheck: Open the contract-creation transaction in the explorer and read its timestamp.

fields.label: the total supply
fields.method: totalSupply()
fields.selfCheck: Read totalSupply() on the token contract in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the burned supply
fields.method: balanceOf(0x...dEaD) + balanceOf(0x0)
fields.selfCheck: Read balanceOf() for the burn addresses in the explorer's Read tab and add them yourself.

fields.label: the locked supply
fields.method: balanceOf(v2LaunchLocker)
fields.selfCheck: Read balanceOf() for the launch locker address in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the circulating supply
fields.method: total_supply - burned_supply - locked_supply
fields.selfCheck: Subtract the burn and locker balances from totalSupply() yourself; all three are readable in the explorer.

fields.label: the pool id
fields.method: PoolInitialized on the meme hook 0xE5e702641Ea86F4ae6cC3cDaeD2B886f976Be044
fields.selfCheck: Find the PoolInitialized log naming this token on the Venue hook in the explorer.
fields.note: The pool id is what per-coin fee attribution hangs on: escrow credits key by (recipient, quoteAsset) and carry no coin identifier, so PoolFeesSwept(poolId, ...) is the only per-coin link.

fields.label: the quote asset address
fields.method: pool key read from the meme hook
fields.selfCheck: Read the pool key for this pool id on the Venue hook in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the quote asset
fields.method: symbol() on the quote asset contract
fields.selfCheck: Read symbol() on the quote asset contract in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the pool quote reserve
fields.method: pool manager balance for the quote asset, pinned by block hash
fields.selfCheck: Read the pool manager's balance of the quote asset in the explorer.

fields.label: the pool token reserve
fields.method: pool manager balance for the token, pinned by block hash
fields.selfCheck: Read the pool manager's balance of the token in the explorer.

fields.label: pool liquidity in USD
fields.method: both reserves valued at a pinned operator price
fields.selfCheck: Read the two pool reserves in the explorer and price them yourself against a source you trust.
fields.note: Declared WEAKER than its inputs on purpose. The reserves are chain reads; the dollars are ours, because the price that converted them came from our feed. A USD figure presented as a chain fact is the quiet overclaim a disclosed operator cannot afford.

fields.label: whether LP is locked
fields.method: launch locker position for this token
fields.selfCheck: Read the launch locker position for this token in the explorer.

fields.label: the LP unlock time
fields.method: unlock timestamp on the launch locker
fields.selfCheck: Read the unlock timestamp on the launch locker in the explorer.

fields.label: the holder count
fields.method: distinct non-zero balances aggregated from Transfer logs
fields.selfCheck: Open the token page on the explorer and read its holders tab.

fields.label: the top-10 holder share
fields.method: sum of the ten largest balances over circulating supply
fields.selfCheck: Open the holders tab on the explorer and add the top ten yourself.

fields.label: the deployer supply share
fields.method: deployer balance over circulating supply
fields.selfCheck: Look up the deployer address on the explorer and read its balance of this token.

fields.label: whether buyback is enabled
fields.method: per-token buyback flag on the meme hook
fields.selfCheck: Read the per-token buyback flag on the Venue hook in the explorer's Read tab.
fields.note: This single flag halves the creator rate: 0.70% of volume off, 0.35% on. Nothing downstream may assume one rate.

fields.label: the creator tax
fields.method: per-token creator tax on the meme hook
fields.selfCheck: Read the per-token creator tax on the Venue hook in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the creator net fee rate
fields.method: creatorNetBps(buyback_enabled, creator_tax_bps) from config/protocol.ts
fields.selfCheck: Read the hook fee, the protocol fee share and the buyback flag in the explorer and compute it yourself.
fields.note: TTL is the shorter of its two inputs, because a derivation cannot outlive the freshest thing it needs.

fields.label: the fee recipient
fields.method: creator fee recipient for this token on the meme hook
fields.selfCheck: Read the creator fee recipient for this token on the Venue hook in the explorer's Read tab.
fields.note: Five minutes, because a stale fee recipient is a security answer and not a trivia answer.

fields.label: a proposed fee-recipient change
fields.method: CreatorFeeRecipientChangeProposed logs naming this token
fields.selfCheck: Search the Venue owner contract in the explorer for CreatorFeeRecipientChangeProposed logs naming this token.

fields.label: fees credited in the last 24h
fields.method: income:fees postings for this vault over the trailing day, at accrual
fields.selfCheck: Sum the PoolFeesSwept logs for this pool id over the last day in the explorer and price them yourself.
fields.note: Our own books, labelled as such. The self-check is the whole point: a holder can reconstruct this from logs without trusting us.

fields.label: lifetime fees credited
fields.method: every income:fees posting for this vault, at accrual
fields.selfCheck: Sum every PoolFeesSwept log for this pool id in the explorer and price them yourself.

fields.label: the initial anti-snipe tax
fields.method: anti-snipe parameters on the meme hook
fields.selfCheck: Read the anti-snipe parameters on the Venue hook in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the anti-snipe window length
fields.method: anti-snipe parameters on the meme hook
fields.selfCheck: Read the anti-snipe parameters on the Venue hook in the explorer's Read tab.

fields.label: the anti-snipe exempt wallets
fields.method: exempt list on the meme hook
fields.selfCheck: Read the exempt list on the Venue hook in the explorer's Read tab.
